title: Database pool exhaustion
content: Database pool exhaustion. Symptoms: HikariPool connection timeout; active=20 pending=84. Diagnosis: Bounded connection pool exhausted; inspect slow queries before changing capacity. Procedure: Verify PostgreSQL headroom and slow query duration. Increase pool only within the database connection budget. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Errors after a deployment
content: Errors after a deployment. Symptoms: HTTP 500 after release v2; previous v1 was healthy. Diagnosis: Deployment regression correlates with increased server errors. Procedure: Compare release versions, confirm rollback compatibility and restore the previous release. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Memory pressure and restarts
content: Memory pressure and restarts. Symptoms: OOMKilled; heap reached container memory limit. Diagnosis: Container memory limit exceeded; heap growth needs investigation. Procedure: Inspect heap and memory leak evidence; apply a bounded memory adjustment and monitor restarts. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: CPU saturation
content: CPU saturation. Symptoms: CPU throttling; request queue growing. Diagnosis: CPU saturation is causing queueing under load. Procedure: Confirm load and downstream capacity, increase replicas by one, then inspect CPU and latency. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Disk nearly full
content: Disk nearly full. Symptoms: No space left on device; archived logs consume disk. Diagnosis: Archived logs are exhausting disk capacity. Procedure: Confirm retention policy and backups; remove only simulated expired archives. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Redis connection failure
content: Redis connection failure. Symptoms: Redis connection refused; endpoint health check failed. Diagnosis: Cache endpoint is unavailable; session requests fail. Procedure: Verify endpoint availability and perform a bounded reconnect with backoff. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Consumer lag growth
content: Consumer lag growth. Symptoms: Consumer processing slow; lag increases with incoming events. Diagnosis: Consumer throughput is lower than event ingress. Procedure: Check partitions and processing errors before adding one consumer. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Expired TLS certificate
content: Expired TLS certificate. Symptoms: TLS certificate has expired; handshake fails. Diagnosis: Expired certificate is causing TLS handshake failures. Procedure: Confirm hostname and certificate chain; simulate certificate renewal and verify handshake. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: DNS resolution errors
content: DNS resolution errors. Symptoms: NXDOMAIN while resolving dependency; cached stale DNS entry. Diagnosis: Stale DNS cache is preventing dependency resolution. Procedure: Compare authoritative DNS results; refresh the simulated local DNS cache. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Upstream rate limiting
content: Upstream rate limiting. Symptoms: Upstream HTTP 429; Retry-After=30; immediate retries increase traffic. Diagnosis: Immediate retries amplify upstream rate limiting. Procedure: Honor Retry-After with bounded exponential backoff and jitter; avoid retry storms. Verification: confirm errors and saturation decrease. Rollback: restore the previous simulated configuration.

title: Diagnose checkout database pool saturation
content: E-commerce checkout connection pool exhaustion under generated traffic. Evidence: measured database active connections approach pool size, waiters increase, checkout connection acquisition timeouts appear in service logs, and checkout latency or error rate rises. Confirm the checkout database pool budget against PostgreSQL capacity and inspect query duration before increasing the limit. Reduce connection hold time or tune the bounded pool only after validating database headroom. Verify waiters and checkout errors fall. Roll back the pool setting if database saturation worsens.

title: Diagnose order worker backlog
content: E-commerce order queue backlog under generated storefront traffic. Evidence: measured pending order queue grows while processed order count stalls and storefront requests continue. Check worker health and downstream inventory latency. Restore worker availability or add bounded consumer capacity after checking idempotency and downstream limits. Verify backlog drains and order completion catches up. Roll back added consumers if downstream saturation increases.
